page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.s2 server family. It is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores, operating with a single thread per core. The instance features 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It runs on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

The hardware profile exhibits a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, aligning it with compute-focused resource distributions. Because the CPU allocation is dedicated rather than shared or burstable, the instance provides stable compute capacity without the performance degradation associated with CPU credit depletion. However, the lack of bundled local storage requires the attachment of external block storage volumes for operating system and application data.

This instance is designed for lightweight workloads requiring consistent CPU performance within a constrained memory footprint. Suitable use cases include small-scale web serving, microservices, lightweight proxy servers, and basic utility applications that do not demand high memory capacity or local disk I/O.
